summary: Surf Air Mobility Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a $15M promissory note with LamVen, secured by aircraft assets of its subsidiaries. Advances are capped at $5M per 90-day period until maturity on April 20, 2029. Interest at 12.5% per annum and a $1.5M origination fee may be paid in cash or common stock valued at $1.274/share. The note is non-recourse to the company, with remedies limited to the borrowers. As a standard debt financing arrangement without equity conversion or change of control, this filing is not a special situation.
